motion.name: state
motion.purpose: color, background-color, border-color, opacity on interactive elements.

components.name: Destructive Solid Button
components.description: Final confirm of an irreversible action.

narrative.overview: A dense, native-feeling control surface in pure neutral greys that follows the OS light/dark scheme. Colour is rationed to status and per-project identity; the primary action is the inverted foreground. Depth is tonal with hairline borders; type is the macOS system face plus Geist Mono.
keyCharacteristics: Pure neutral surface ladder, no chromatic accent.
Status is carried by shape plus colour, never colour alone.
4/6/8px radii, 1px borders, a single overlay shadow.
One 120ms ease-out rhythm for state changes.

rules.name: The Status-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Chromatic colour means status or project identity. Chrome and actions stay neutral.

rules.name: The Surface Ladder Rule
rules.body: chrome < background < panel < overlay. Pick the step; do not invent a grey.

rules.name: The Small Ramp Rule
rules.body: Use the five named sizes; no ad-hoc pixel sizes.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces separate with a 1px border or a surface step, never a shadow.

dos: Do use the global :focus-visible outline as the only focus style.
Do pair status colour with a shape or label.
Do keep transitions to 120ms ease-out and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use project hues only through avatars, with avatar-ink as foreground.
Do build modals on DialogShell and full pages on PageHeader.
donts: Don't add per-component focus rings or glow.
Don't use shadows on resting surfaces, blur or glass, or radii above 8px.
Don't add a chromatic brand accent.
Don't use destructive-solid for anything but the final irreversible confirm.
